item.description: El histórico narcotraficante Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo falleció este 15 de noviembre a los 80 años. Su salud se había deteriorado notablemente en los últimos años por padecimientos como hipertensión, diabetes y sordera. Informe de nuestro corresponsal, Jorge Hurtado. item.title: Charleston opens $25m memorial 11 years after church shooting killed nine Black worshippers
item.description: In Charleston, South Carolina, the Emanuel Nine Memorial has been unveiled, marking over a decade since the heart-wrenching shooting. Families and community figures participated in the dedication ceremony, honoring those lost in the tragic event. The memorial features peaceful benches and a beautiful fountain, designed for contemplation and remembrance. Chris Singleton emphasized its personal importance in honoring his mother's legacy. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Pragues's fight for public TV - Why Renowned Presenter Will Leave Czech TV Over Reforms
item.description: Daniel Stach, one of the Czech Republic’s best-known television presenters, tells Gavin Lee on France 24 why he is prepared to walk away from his career rather than work under changes that he says will threaten the independence of public broadcasting. As hundreds of thousands take to the streets of Prague, Stach explains why he is joining the protests against the government’s proposed overhaul of public media funding – and what is at stake for Czech television, journalism and democracy. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Trident nuclear submarine concludes record underwater deployment
item.description: HMS Vengeance’s seven-month patrol prompts fears over slow pace of maintenance of ageing fleet and strain on crew A Trident nuclear submarine has concluded a record seven-month deployment, returning to the Faslane naval base in Scotland where its crew was greeted by the defence secretary, Wes Streeting. HMS Vengeance began its patrol on 12 April and spent 217 days submerged before returning on Sunday, having left the country when Keir Starmer was in Downing Street and Manchester United were third in the Premier League. item.title: An Australian railway enthusiast spent 13 years building a mini version of a 315-kilometre route
item.description: After 13 years of meticulous work, Peter Michalak has crafted a stunning miniature railway that faithfully mirrors the Adelaide-to-Bridgewater route. This impressive model showcases various stations across a detailed 315-kilometre stretch. Initially designed to be portable, the project has since transitioned into a permanent display rich in detail, reflecting Michalak's family history and personal ties to the railway. Efforts are ongoing to enhance this intricate layout over the next decade. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: León XIV viaja a Cuzco, a 3.400 metros de altura, donde pone a prueba su salud: «Es un milagro que haya venido desde Roma»
item.description: El Papa se ha desplazado hasta Cuzco, a 3.400 metros de altura, para visitar el corazón histórico y espiritual del mundo andino. En las ruinas de una antigua fortaleza inca ha reivindicado que la fe católica «reconcilia en una época marcada por heridas y divisiones». Le han escuchado decenas de miles de personas, muchas de ellas procedentes de zonas aisladas que han hecho días de camino para verle unos instantes en estas cumbres. Aunque la etapa en la zona andina ha durado menos de cuatro horas, el 'soroche' o mal de altura ha puesto de nuevo a prueba la salud del Pontífice, operado del… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Humane World for Animals rescues 951 chinchillas from Ohio breeding facility in two operations
item.description: A breeding facility in Jenera, Ohio, was revealed to have hundreds of chinchillas in poor conditions. Federal inspections led to the discovery of severe neglect and health issues in the animals. Humane World for Animals assisted in the rescue of 951 chinchillas, which were removed in two operations. The facility's owner agreed to surrender the animals and cease operations regulated by the Animal Welfare Act. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Véronique Lecaros: "La Iglesia católica se ha dado cuenta de la importancia de las tradiciones"
item.description: En su visita a Cusco, el papa León XIV fue recibido por cientos de fieles en el Parque Arqueológico de Sacsayhuamán, ubicada en la parte alta del Cusco, sobre los 3.700 metros de altura sobre el nivel del mar, donde resaltó la importancia de las tradiciones de los pueblos. Para nuestra invitada, la doctora Véronique Lecaros, jefa del Departamento de Teología de la PUCP, "las tradiciones son una fuerza" que va de la mano con la Iglesia católica. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
